item.title: Authorities rescue rare endemic rodent in Aurora town
item.description: BALER, Aurora (PIA) — Authorities rescued a rare Northern Luzon giant cloud rat (Phloeomys pallidus) from a residence in Casiguran, Aurora and safely released back into its natural habitat.
